war_summary: War 139 is on day 87 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map shows a heavily polarized stalemate: many regions are fully consolidated by one side, while the active fronts are concentrated in a handful of contested hexes. The hottest fighting by casualty rates is in Callahans Passage (~537/498 casualties per 2h), Olavis Wake (~511/423), Clahstra (~463/480), Dead Lands (~265/457), Endless Shore (~245/450), and Speaking Woods (~424/411). Base-flip activity in the last 24h is concentrated in Oarbreaker (26 events, ongoing as of cutoff), Mooring County (22), Stlican Shelf (22), Clahstra (19), Onyx (14), plus smaller activity in Endless Shore, Olavis Wake, Tempest Isle (a base just went neutral at cutoff), Morgens Crossing, Stema Landing, and Palantine Berm. Oarbreaker and Tempest Isle are the only regions with events inside the last ~2 hours, indicating live operations. Uncertainty is high: the event history window covers only ~5 hours, most casualty 'accelerating' signals reflect the recent-hour spike after a quiet prior hour rather than sustained escalation, and several hot-casualty hexes show no base flips yet, so it is unclear whether current pressure will translate into ownership changes within 24h.
